name: @browser-debug-bridge/chrome-extension
description: Manifest V3 Chrome extension for Browser Debug Bridge.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.console-hook.config.ts
scripts.test: tsx --test src/capture/selectors.test.ts src/capture/css.test.ts src/capture/dom.test.ts src/capture/session.test.ts src/capture/tab-hash.test.ts src/capture/screenshot-geometry.test.ts src/capture/screenshot.test.ts src/capture/console/serializer.test.ts src/capture/console/buffer.test.ts src/capture/console/entries.test.ts src/capture/console/redact.test.ts
